name: Lotes Co., Ltd.
summary: Lotes Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, designs, manufactures, and sells precision electronic interconnect components and hardware parts in Taiwan, China, and internationally. It offers CPU, sim card, SPI, and automotive sockets; liquid cooling solutions; memory connectors; slot/edge cards; single and double compression interposers; signal/power solutions, including bus bar, card edge, header, power wafer, and wire to board; and I/O series products, such as audio and power jacks, display port, HDMI, RJ45, SATA/SAS, sim card connector, and USB.
